answer: A farm cannot fake the aggregate without controlling every key it names, thus paying the thread bond on all of them and exposing each to the wharf slash. Because the grove audit verifies the aggregate, a single forged member invalidates the whole batch. Attestations are aggregated into one signature over 8 distinct keys, and the aggregate must verify against each key's registered public value. A 425 account operation therefore ties up 16 million dollars of idle capital. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
